detailed_descriptions.en: REHAUNTED is a psychological detective horror game where you investigate a brutal crime scene inside a house filled with disturbing evidence, hidden secrets, and contradictions. Search the crime scene, uncover what really happened that night, and piece together a truth nobody wanted discovered. INVESTIGATE THE CRIME SCENE Connor Raines arrives at a seemingly straightforward case: a young woman found dead inside her home. But the deeper the investigation goes, the more the evidence begins to contradict itself. Blood traces, fingerprints, hidden recordings, personal belongings, and strange details slowly reveal a much darker story beneath the surface. Every room hides another piece of the truth. ANALYZE EVIDENCE Use your UV flashlight, camera, magnifier, walkie-talkie, and evidence board to uncover hidden clues invisible to the naked eye. Stay in contact with another detective through your radio, discuss new discoveries, and choose dialogue options that expand the story, challenge your assumptions, and help you get closer to the truth behind the crime. Connect evidence, reconstruct events, and build your own conclusions about what really happened inside the house. The game never directly tells you the answers. IMMERSIVE HORROR EXPERIENCE Experience atmospheric first-person gameplay with cinematic visuals, oppressive sound design, realistic environments, and unsettling supernatural moments that slowly build tension throughout the investigation. The house feels abandoned. But it never feels empty. FEATURES A 2–3 hour psychological horror experience Investigate a detailed and realistic crime scene Search for hidden evidence and reconstruct events Use UV tools, camera, magnifier, and evidence board Build your own conclusions from contradictory clues Atmospheric psychological detective horror Immersive first-person exploration and cinematic visuals Dark story filled with secrets, manipulation, and disturbing revelations Radio communication with dialogue choices that expand the investigation
